title: PRISM/AI — Config
description: Configuration schema for a PRISM/AI landscape. Declares scope, risk class, and active dimensions for an AI architecture engagement.

prism_ai_version.description: Schema version for PRISM/AI artifacts in this landscape.

organization.description: Name of the organization this landscape belongs to.

product.description: Product or platform scope, if narrower than the full organization.

temporal_state.description: Whether this config describes current reality, an in-flight change, or a desired future state.

as_of.description: ISO 8601 date this config accurately reflected the landscape.

active_dimensions.description: Which PRISM/AI dimensions are actively maintained in this landscape.

ai_risk_class.description: EU AI Act risk classification for the AI systems in scope.

human_in_loop_required.description: Whether all AI-driven decisions in this landscape require a human review step before acting.

author.description: Author or owner of this landscape.

contact.description: Contact email or handle for questions about this landscape.

created_date.description: ISO 8601 date when this landscape was first created.

last_modified.description: ISO 8601 date of the last modification.

reviewed_by.description: Name or handle of last reviewer.

review_date.description: ISO 8601 date of last formal review.
